meta.name: render-cinematic-music-video
meta.description: Assemble a cinematic live-action-style music-video ad from a config — an original sung anthem carries the whole narrative while N 35mm-film-look i2v clips are each cut to their lyric window and hard-concatenated on the beat as a 3-act arc, the anthem muxed at loudnorm I=-14, cinematic lower-third serif captions built from the song's OWN word timings (never Whisper) with the hook line landing on the chorus drop, and closed on a brand end card composited from the real asset — never AI-rendered text. This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (cut-to-window + hard concat + anthem mux + captions + end card); the anthem, keyframes, and clips come from create-music-elevenlabs / create-image-fal / create-video-fal. Use for the cinematic-music-video format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将歌词、画面和音乐自动合成电影级音乐视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从歌词、画面和音乐自动生成电影级音乐视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble a cinematic music video ad from lyrics, visuals, and music automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically generate a cinematic music video ad from lyrics, visuals, and music.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装一段电影风格的音乐视频广告：将原创歌曲、35mm胶片风格的视频片段、歌词字幕和品牌结尾卡片拼接成三段式叙事短片，并输出最终视频文件。
howto.when: 当你提供原创歌曲（含歌词时间戳）、每个节拍的视频片段和品牌结尾卡片素材时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这些素材组装一个音乐视频广告。
say.note: Claude 会按配置拼接视频、歌曲和字幕。

say.text: 把这段歌词对应的视频片段剪到节拍上。
say.note: Claude 会根据歌词时间戳精确裁剪视频。

say.text: 在副歌高潮处突出显示这句歌词。
say.note: Claude 会在字幕中特殊标记该句。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can assemble a cinematic music-video ad from a config: it cuts video clips to lyric windows, hard-concatenates on beat, muxes the anthem, burns lower-third captions from the song's own word timings, and overlays a brand end card, outputting a 1080×1920 h264+aac master.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide the original sung anthem (with word timestamps), one video clip per beat, and the brand end-card asset.

say_en.text: Assemble a music video ad from these assets.
say_en.note: Claude will concatenate clips, mux anthem, and add captions.

say_en.text: Cut this clip to the lyric window and sync to beat.
say_en.note: Claude trims the clip to match the lyric phrase.

say_en.text: Highlight this hook line on the chorus drop.
say_en.note: Claude accents that line in the captions.
